Message.Name: Quotation Message
Message.Description: Combined Quotation Report of the Nasdaq Canada best bid and offer, with size attributed to the CXC and CX2 trading books.

Field.Name: Time Stamp
Field.Description: Denotes the time stamp of the Nasdaq Canada trading book that generated the quote message.

Field.Name: Stock Symbol
Field.Description: Denotes the Nasdaq Canada stock identifier for which the QBBO quotation message is being generated.

Field.Name: Nasdaq Canada Best Bid Price
Field.Description: Denotes the best bid price across Nasdaq Canada Market Centers.

Field.Name: Nasdaq Canada Best Bid Size
Field.Description: Denotes the aggregated number of shares available for display within the Nasdaq Canada trading book(s) at the best bid price.

Field.Name: Nasdaq CXC Best Bid Size
Field.Description: Denotes the aggregated number of shares available for display within the Nasdaq CXC trading book at the Nasdaq Canada best bid price.

Field.Name: Nasdaq CX2 Best Bid Size
Field.Description: Denotes the aggregated number of shares available for display within the Nasdaq CX2 trading book at the Nasdaq Canada best bid price.

Field.Name: Nasdaq Canada Best Ask Price
Field.Description: Denotes the best ask price across Nasdaq Canada Market Centers.

Field.Name: Nasdaq Canada Best Ask Size
Field.Description: Denotes the aggregated number of shares available for display within the Nasdaq Canada trading book(s) at the best ask price.

Field.Name: Nasdaq CXC Best Ask Size
Field.Description: Denotes the aggregated number of shares available for display within the Nasdaq CXC trading book at the Nasdaq Canada best ask price.

Field.Name: Nasdaq CX2 Best Ask Size
Field.Description: Denotes the aggregated number of shares available for display within the Nasdaq CX2 trading book at the Nasdaq Canada best ask price.

Message.Name: Trade Report Message
Message.Description: Relays all transactions available from or reported by the three Nasdaq Canada Trading Books for the current business day.

Field.Name: Time Stamp
Field.Description: Denotes the time stamp of the Nasdaq Canada trading book that generated the trade message.

Field.Name: Originating Market Center Identifier
Field.Description: Denotes the Nasdaq Canada trading book that generated the trade message.

Field.Name: Stock Symbol
Field.Description: Denotes the Nasdaq Canada stock identifier of the security for which the trade report is being generated.

Field.Name: Trade Number
Field.Description: Indicates the source's internal number associated with the given trade transaction.

Field.Name: Trade Price
Field.Description: The price associated with the trade transaction being reported.

Field.Name: Trade Size
Field.Description: Indicates the reported number of shares on the trade transaction.

Field.Name: Broker
Field.Description: The three digit numeric Broker Number of the buyer, or 001 for anonymous.

Field.Name: Contra Broker
Field.Description: The three digit numeric Broker Number of the seller, or 001 for anonymous.

Field.Name: Sale Condition Modifier
Field.Description: Sale condition modifier consists of four levels.

Field.Name: Consolidated Trade Volume
Field.Description: Reflects the volume for the Stock Symbol as reported by each exchange at the time that the trade message was generated.

Message.Name: Trade Break Message
Message.Description: Sent if a Trade is cancelled during the same day as its execution.

Field.Name: Time Stamp
Field.Description: Denotes the time stamp of the Nasdaq system that generated the Trade Break.

Field.Name: Trade Control Number
Field.Description: Indicates the source's internal control number associated with the given trade transaction.

Field.Name: Originating Market Center Identifier
Field.Description: Denotes the Nasdaq Canada trading book that generated the trade break message.

Message.Name: Trade Correction Message
Message.Description: Sent if a Trade is corrected during the same day as its execution.

Field.Name: Time Stamp
Field.Description: Denotes the time stamp of the Nasdaq Canada trading book that generated the trade correction.

Field.Name: Originating Market Center Identifier
Field.Description: Denotes the Nasdaq Canada trading book that generated the trade correction.

Field.Name: Stock Symbol
Field.Description: Denotes the Nasdaq Canada stock symbol of the security for which the trade correction is being generated.

Field.Name: Original Trade Number
Field.Description: Indicates the source's internal number associated with the given trade transaction.

Field.Name: Original Trade Price
Field.Description: The price associated with the original trade transaction.

Field.Name: Original Trade Size
Field.Description: Indicates the reported number of shares on the original trade transaction.

Field.Name: Corrected Trade Price
Field.Description: The price associated with the trade correction being reported.

Field.Name: Corrected Trade Size
Field.Description: Indicates the reported number of shares on the trade correction.

Message.Name: System Event Message
Message.Description: Issued to indicate a market state event.

Field.Name: Time Stamp
Field.Description: Denotes the time stamp of the Nasdaq Canada trading book that generated the system event message.

Field.Name: Originating Market Center Identifier
Field.Description: Denotes the Nasdaq Canada trading book that generated the event message.

Field.Name: Event Code
Field.Description: Denotes the Nasdaq Canada market system event code.

Message.Name: Stock Directory Message
Message.Description: Disseminated at the start of each trading day for all active symbols in the Nasdaq Execution system.

Field.Name: Time Stamp
Field.Description: Denotes the time stamp of the Nasdaq Canada trading book that generated the stock directory message.

Field.Name: Stock Symbol
Field.Description: Denotes the Nasdaq Canada stock symbol of the security for which the message is being generated.

Field.Name: Stock Display Name
Field.Description: 1*40 Printable ASCII; no default

Field.Name: Listing Market
Field.Description: Indicates the primary listing market for the stock.

Field.Name: Board Lot Size
Field.Description: Denotes the Board Lot Size of the Symbol

Field.Name: Currency
Field.Description: Denotes the Currency of the Symbol

Message.Name: Stock Status Message
Message.Description: Indicates the current trading status of a stock.

Field.Name: Time Stamp
Field.Description: Denotes the time stamp of the Nasdaq Canada trading book that generated the stock status message.

Field.Name: Stock Symbol
Field.Description: Denotes the Nasdaq Canada symbol of the security for which the message is being generated.

Field.Name: Market
Field.Description: Denotes the Nasdaq Canada trading book that generated the message.

Field.Name: System Status
Field.Description: Denotes whether the trading state of the Canada trading books is currently halted.

Message.Name: End of Day Trade Summary Message
Message.Description: Published once at 4:15PM and again at 5:15PM, including all traded symbols from the day.

Field.Name: Time Stamp
Field.Description: Denotes the time stamp of the Nasdaq Canada trading book that generated the trade message.

Field.Name: Stock Symbol
Field.Description: Denotes the Nasdaq Canada stock identifier of the security for which the trade report is being generated.

Field.Name: Consolidated High Price
Field.Description: The highest price of any high/low eligible transaction on the trading day for any exchange.

Field.Name: Consolidated Low Price
Field.Description: The lowest price of any high/low eligible transaction on the trading day for any exchange.

Field.Name: Consolidated Open Price
Field.Description: The first last sale eligible transactions received on the trading day for any participating exchange.

Field.Name: Listing Center Open Price
Field.Description: The first last sale eligible transactions received on the trading day from the primary listing exchange.

Field.Name: Consolidated Close Price
Field.Description: The final last sale eligible transaction on any participating exchange received on the trading day.

Field.Name: Listing Center Close Price
Field.Description: The final last sale eligible transactions received on the trading day from the primary listing exchange.

Field.Name: Consolidated Volume
Field.Description: Reflects the sum of the total volume for the issue from all participating exchanges.

Message.Name: Adjusted Closing Price Message
Message.Description: Previous Day Adjusted Close Price, sent at 7:00AM to reflect any adjustments made overnight.

Field.Name: Time Stamp
Field.Description: Time Stamp.

Field.Name: Issue Symbol
Field.Description: Denotes the security symbol for the issue in the Nasdaq execution system.

Field.Name: Security Class
Field.Description: Indicates the primary listing market for the issue.

Field.Name: Adjusted Closing Price
Field.Description: The previous trading day's official closing price adjusted for any applicable corporate actions.

Field.Description: Used for Trade Attribute Information

Field.Name: Sales Condition Modifier Level 2
Field.Description: Used for Cross Type Information

Field.Name: Sales Condition Modifier Level 3
Field.Description: Used for Settlement Terms Information

Field.Name: Sales Condition Modifier Level 4
Field.Description: Used for Board Lot Eligibility Information

Enum.Name: Originating Market Center Identifier
Enum.Description: Denotes the Nasdaq Canada trading book that generated the message

Value.Name: All Markets

Enum.Name: Sales Condition Modifier Level 4
Enum.Description: Used for Board Lot Eligibility Information

Enum.Name: Event Code
Enum.Description: Denotes the Nasdaq Canada market system event code

Value.Name: Start Of Nasdaq Canada Trading Session
Value.Description: Start of Nasdaq Canada Trading Session

Value.Name: Start Of Primary Market Trading Activity Session
Value.Description: Start of Primary Market Trading Activity Session

Value.Name: End Of Primary Market Trading Session
Value.Description: End of Primary Market Trading Session. Indicates the Pegged orders are no longer available for execution

Value.Name: End Of Nasdaq Canada Trading Session
Value.Description: End of Nasdaq Canada Trading Session

Value.Name: End Of Messages
Value.Description: End of Messages. Last message of the day
